A pasted mega.nz folder brings all of its files, and the logo is back without its tile in the browser toolbar.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A pasted cloud folder, such as a mega.nz folder link, becomes one row per file in it.** The folder link stayed a single row, and only one file came down. KnightLoader now hands such a link to JDownloader, which opens the folder, and the files take its place in the collector. This needs JDownloader, which the desktop app brings along. Thanks to [@jirat-sumitanun](https://github.com/jirat-sumitanun) for reporting it in [#147](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/147).
- **The browser extension's toolbar button shows the logo without a tile again.** 2.6.1 put it back on the phone app's white square. The web interface's install icons are bare as well; only the Android app keeps the tile.
- **The desktop installer's window shows the touched-up logo** of 2.6.1, and its grey buttons take on a touch of the app's colour when you point at them, through PommelPorter 1.1.1.
- **The GlimStone link on the Version card opens again.** GlimStone folded 3.8.6 into 3.9.0, so the card names 3.9.0, the same design.
